items.headline: Marshall Faulk, Hall of Famer and Southern coach, reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
items.description: Marshall Faulk said that in discussing his illness in a podcast appearance Wednesday, "I want to help as many people as I can."

items.headline: San Diego State visits Colorado State in Pac-12 action
items.description: San Diego State (3-4) at Colorado State (2-4), Oct. 24 at 6:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: DiLeva kicks career-long 53-yard FG in closing seconds, San Diego St. beats Fresno St. 26-23
items.description: — Jayden Denegal and wide receiver Bert Emanuel Jr. each threw a touchdown pass, Cooper DiLeva kicked a career-long 53-yard field goal with 57 seconds left, and San Diego State beat Fresno State 26-23 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Fresno State visits San Diego State in Pac-12 action
items.description: Fresno State (4-2) at San Diego State (2-4), Oct. 17 at 10:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Repeat performance: Atkinson again throws 5 TD passes in Oregon State's rout of San Diego State
items.description: — Braden Atkinson threw for 409 yards and tied his career high with five touchdown passes and Oregon State beat San Diego State 66-14 on Saturday.

items.headline: College football Week 6 best bets: White Out game leads the card
items.description: Pamela Maldonado and Mark Zinno break down the best bets they see around college football for Week 6.
